title: Senior Manager, Quality and Safety — Cardiac PET/CT
description:
THE COMPANY
At Cardiovascular Associates of America (CVAUSA), we believe that the total cost of cardiovascular care is too high and the optimal way to identify and remove the avoidable costs in cardiovascular care delivery is by equipping and empowering cardiovascular physicians with new care models and new financial incentives via risk-based contracts.

Position Summary
CVAUSA is seeking a Senior Manager of Quality and Safety for Cardiac PET to lead the standardization and continuous improvement of cardiac PET/CT imaging across our network of community cardiology practices. This person will own the quality framework for one of the fastest-growing and most technically demanding imaging modalities in cardiovascular care - setting the standards, building the improvement programs, and working directly with practices to raise the floor and the ceiling on imaging quality, patient safety, and diagnostic accuracy. This is a hands-on role for someone who has spent years inside real-world cardiac PET programs, knows exactly where quality tends to break down in community practice, and is energized by the work of closing those gaps at scale.

Key Responsibilities
Quality Program Development & Management

• Refine, implement, and iteratively improve upon CVAUSA’s initial quality and safety program for cardiac PET/CT across CVAUSA’s practice network.

• Establish and maintain quality metrics, protocols, and standard operating procedures spanning acquisition, stress protocols, tracer handling, quantification (myocardial blood flow / flow reserve), and interpretation.

• Build dashboards and reporting that make imaging quality and outcomes visible and actionable at both the network and individual-site level.

Accreditation

• Serve as the network's subject-matter expert on PET/CT accreditation requirements (e.g., IAC, ACR) and ensure practices meet or exceed accreditation quality criteria.

• Support practices as needed through initial accreditation and re-accreditation as needed, including documentation, QC records, and required competencies.

• Partner with the Medical Director and Radiation Safety Officer, who retain final sign-off on all clinical protocol specifics (dosing, contraindications, supervision levels) driven through this role.

Peer Review & Clinical Validation

• Establish and run routine peer review / over-read programs for interpreting physicians, with structured feedback and improvement pathways.

• Design and operationalize systematic comparisons of PET/CT findings against invasive coronary angiography, using discordance analysis to identify interpretation, protocol, and quantification issues and drive corrective action.

• Design analyses that leverage billing and electronic health record data to understand patterns of care quality and identify variations in utilization and clinical outcomes across practices and patient populations.

Training & Competency

• Implement, refine, and iteratively improve upon existing quality-focused training and competency requirements for interpreting clinicians.

• Develop training content to help standardize clinician continuing education for PET/CT.

Site Assessment & Standardization

• Travel to affiliated practices to assess PET/CT programs end to end - equipment and QC, protocols, staff competency, workflow, and image quality.

• Identify site-specific and network-wide sources of variation and poor-quality imaging (e.g., PET/CT misregistration and attenuation-correction artifacts, patient motion, stress protocol inconsistency, generator/tracer handling, calibration and QC gaps, reader variability) and lead remediation.

Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

• Apply core quality-improvement methodology (e.g., PDSA cycles, root-cause analysis, statistical process control) to reduce variation and improve diagnostic accuracy and safety.

• Set benchmarks, track performance over time, and partner with practice leadership to sustain gains.

Required Qualifications

• 5-10+ years

title: Driver / Data Collector in Sevilla, Spain
description:
Company description
 
Terry Soot Management Group (TSMG) is a field data collection company founded in 2017 in Europe. We collect data where automation is not possible. We count features, take pictures, make videos, record speech, and scan areas for every detail you need to make more informed decisions. Our field data collection teams are spread across Europe and North America, ready to accept new challenges.
 
 
Project Overview
 
This project aims to collect high-quality visuals of streets, key points of interest, and public spaces across EU countries. Using vehicles equipped with removable 360° cameras and lidars, drivers will capture comprehensive images of the surroundings. The captured data will be stored on onboard computers (SSD Drives)  and later utilized to enhance one of the world’s leading online mapping platforms.
 
Data collectors will follow pre-assigned routes, focusing on public streets, commercial areas, and points of interest. To ensure the highest image quality, certain areas may need to be revisited during favorable weather conditions. 
The duration of the project varies based on the scope of work required in each targeted data collection area. On average, the assignments involve 3 to 6 months of active work.

The recruitment process for the position of a Driver involves such steps: safety driving test, interview with recruiter, and onboarding process.

If you’re interested, apply now and join us in shaping the future of data collection!

title: Liquidity reporting Compliance

Policy or local policy representatives.

The role will involve close liaison with the Product Owner for Liquidity Reporting in identifying the epics delivered in the previous release to be tested for compliance; documenting the test cases required for compliance testing by reference to required instructions, regulations and policy; managing test execution by a small team of dedicated testers; analyse test results for compliance with the testers; flag any items which require further investigation; identify any cases of non-compliance back to stakeholders including Reporting Ops and Report Owners; provide rapid feedback to the build team in cases of re-build required for compliance.

Working knowledge of SQL to run query’s as required in the cloud platform test environment to support test case formulation, and to understand any logic build to verify code compliance to requirement.

Experience with use of ETL documents and related SQL scripts to understand detailed data transformations as well as being able to explain these to less technical colleagues

Competence in dealing with large complex datasets and using data analysis skills to manipulate and interrogate the data to produce findings

Able to engage with Reporting Ops to articulate all test findings, including compliant and non-compliant findings, alongside expected impact of any change requirements due to non-compliance defect fixes.

At Hasbro and Wizards of the Coast, you’ll collaborate with passionate teams to reimagine our iconic brands and create experiences that spark joy, connection, and community through the magic of play. title: Technical Support Specialist
description:
Fin is the AI Customer Agent company on a mission to help businesses provide perfect customer experiences.

Our AI Agent Fin is the highest-performing AI Customer Agent on the market today, enabling businesses to deliver impeccable, always-on customer support across the customer journey - from service, to sales, to ecommerce. Powered by our own AI models, Fin resolves complex customer issues end-to-end across every channel, with minimal set-up and integration. Fin can also be combined with our natively integrated Intercom help desk for one single system that is designed to meet the needs of modern day support teams.

Founded in 2011, Fin became one of the fastest growing companies and remains one of the largest private software companies in the world with nearly 30,000 global businesses using our products to transform their customer support. Driven by our core values, we push boundaries, build with speed and intensity, and relentlessly deliver incredible value to our customers.

What's the opportunity? 

With the advent of AI, the nature of customer support has changed dramatically - as have the humans who provide it. Our next Technical Support Specialist will be someone who thrives in autonomy, is deeply curious, fluent in AI tools and holds an extremely high bar not just for themselves, but for their teammates.

As a Technical Support Specialist, you'll own complex technical queries around some of our most nuanced features, serve as a point of escalation for your colleagues for the most tricky investigations, consistently provide world class customer support, collaborate with our customers proactively to help them make the most of our platform and help drive improvements in product, processes, and peer development. You'll use AI tools alongside your own expertise to handle complex cases efficiently and play a role in shaping a culture of continuous improvement. We ship product updates consistently, so if constant learning excites and energises you, this environment will suit you well!

If this is the kind of role that excites you, then we want you as our next Technical Support Specialist.

What will I be doing? 

• Communicating efficiently and effectively with our customers - we use our own product to do most of our support, but outbound phone calls are part of our offering too.

• Start talking to customers in the inbox and build “inboxing” fundamentals through Paired Inboxing sessions.

In your first 60 days, you will: 

• Continue to complete CS trainings and pass relevant assessment

description:

About the Company
TalentPluto is a Y Combinator-backed startup building the hiring stack for high-growth companies. We run two connected products: a talent network that places engineering, go-to-market, and operations people into fast-moving startups, and an AI recruiting tool that lets a hiring team run candidate search, tiered enrichment, rubric-based scoring, and outbound campaigns directly from their assistant. The Opportunity
This is a Founders Associate internship working directly with the founders on whatever matters most that week. The work moves between strategy, analysis, and execution: scoping a question nobody has answered yet, doing the research, forming a recommendation, and then owning the follow-through until it is actually done. You will see how an early-stage company gets built from the inside, including the parts that are unglamorous and still undecided.
Because the team is small, the projects are real and the ownership is genuine. Expect limited structure, frequent context switching, and a high bar on written communication, since most decisions here are made from a well-argued document rather than a meeting.
Responsibilities

• Own discrete, high-impact projects end to end for the founders, from framing the question through to the recommendation and the follow-through.

• Research markets, competitors, customers, and internal data, and turn findings into clear written recommendations.

• Move between strategy, analysis, and hands-on execution depending on what the week requires.

• Build lightweight process and documentation where none exists, so the same work does not have to be redone.

• Track commitments across the team and make sure decisions turn into action.

Requirements

• Strong judgment, organization, and follow-through on work with limited supervision.

• Excellent written communication, including the ability to synthesize a messy problem into a clear argument.

• Strong research skills across both public sources and internal data.

• Comfort switching between strategy, analysis, and execution.

• Ability to work on ambiguous projects with limited structure.

• High ownership mindset and self-direction in a remote startup environment.

The clinical protocols, the measurement science, the precision medicine, the technology to deliver coordinated longitudinal outpatient care for this population. None of it has been built. We are developing all of it. The care, the science, the technology.

title: Buyer
description:
At Sunrun , we’re on a mission to change the way the world interacts with energy, and we’re building a company and brand that puts power at the center of life. To do it, we’re designing a dynamic culture where employee development, well-being, and safety come first. It’s why we’ve become the #1 home solar and battery company in America. We’re unlike any other residential energy company. Our vertically integrated model gives us total control over every part of the energy lifecycle - from sale through installation and beyond - so you can find endless opportunities for growth. Come join a career you can grow in and a culture you can run with.
Who We Are
We’re on a mission to make energy more reliable and affordable for more people. We provide an opportunity with storage and solar to help people access greater energy independence without the big upfront costs. Sunrun is the largest dedicated residential solar and storage company in the country and has a mission to bring stably priced resilient power to the masses.

Overview
The Sr. Buyer purchases of goods and services for the company. The Sr. Buyer drives the procurement process and closely interacts with multiple internal departments to assist and review business requirements. This role negotiates with suppliers on a regular basis, sets and achieves cost reduction targets, examines prices, reviews and manages availability of products or services; compares scopes of work and reviews alternatives to fulfill objectives. The Sr. Buyer updates procurement policy and procedural documentation as needed.
Responsibilities

• Oversees the purchase order (PO) placing process to ensure on time delivery of product and on-time payment of all invoices

• Leads the exception management process and holds suppliers accountable when POs come through with inaccurate detail

• Creates purchase orders from requisitions

• Facilitates periodic requests for quote to all appropriate vendors to insure competitive pricing and payment terms, as well as managing the portfolio of items that the company carries

• Analyzes spend data seeking opportunities to reduce cost, consolidate spend and support in sourcing strategy development

• Identifies and executes cost and payment terms improvement plans with suppliers

• Monitors supplier performance by ensuring that product is delivered as scheduled and meets specifications; maintaining a supplier scorecard to ensure company requirements are met and supplier is aware of their performance

• Negotiates contracts, improved prices and terms of business with suppliers and reviews opportunities to make business savings utilizing negotiation and procurement best practice tools and methods

• Supports leadership with driving cost, technology and value improvements with suppliers across the Supply Chain

Qualifications

• High school diploma or equivalent

• Bachelor's degree preferred

• Minimum of 5 years of progressive purchasing experience in related field

• Ability to effectively participate as a member of a project team, interfacing with various departmental representatives

• Analytical capability in terms of metrics, volumes, trends, financial information is required

• Excellent written and oral communication skills are required

• Ability to prioritize and coordinate multiple tasks and projects in an environment of competing priorities

• Solid problem solving and decision making skills

• Strong computer skills including G-Suite knowledge, MS Word and MS PowerPoint

• Advanced MS Excel skills

• Experience in Oracle / SAP / Similar ERP

We are seeking an accomplished and strategically minded Group Chief Financial Officer (Group CFO) to lead the financial strategy, performance, capital management, investment finance, and financial governance of a diversified Insurance & Investments Group.
The Group CFO will have enterprise-wide responsibility for the Group's financial affairs, overseeing finance across subsidiaries, business units, investment entities, and operating companies.
As a key member of the Group Executive Leadership Team, the Group CFO will serve as a strategic advisor to the Group CEO, President, Board, Investment Committee, and other senior stakeholders, ensuring disciplined capital allocation, strong financial performance, balance-sheet resilience, regulatory compliance, and long-term shareholder value creation.
The role requires a sophisticated financial leader with experience across insurance, investment management, asset management, financial services, corporate finance, capital markets, and regulated financial institutions.
Key Responsibilities
1. Group Financial Strategy & Leadership
Develop and execute the Group's overall financial strategy in alignment with corporate objectives.
Provide strategic financial advice to the Group CEO, President, Board, and Executive Committee.
Establish Group-wide financial policies, standards, controls, and performance frameworks.
Ensure effective financial governance across subsidiaries, business units, joint ventures, and investment entities.
Lead the development of the Group's long-term financial and capital strategy.

Challenge business-unit leadership on financial performance and corrective actions.

Monitor actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and strategic objectives.
Strengthen management reporting and financial analytics.

Nysonian builds the next generation of global lifestyle brands; brands that inspire how people travel, move, and live. We create not just products, but experiences that empower people worldwide.

Our Fast-Growing Portfolio Includes:

• NOBL Travel - redefining modern travel with design, durability, and performance

• FLO Pilates - bringing Pilates into homes and wardrobes globally

With $150M+ in revenue, 300+ teammates across 6 countries, and 1.3M+ customers worldwide, we are shaping the brands that will define the next decade.

To be considered for this job beside Appling, you need to fill out this form. Any candidate without this form will be immediately disqualified.

We are looking for a Video Editor to create high-performing paid social video ads for Nysonian 's brands. title: Search Engine Optimization (SEO) Internship
description:
Looking for hands-on experience in search and content marketing? Our career-launching intern program is calling your name!
The SEO Sherpa internship is a 12-week fast-start into a search engine marketing career.
You’ll get to learn, grow, and develop your skills in all aspects of search engine marketing, from pay-per-click advertising to organic SEO, and content marketing to conversion rate optimization (CRO) and overall account management of campaigns with various budgets. The program will inspire, educate, and prepare you to succeed in an entry-level role at SEO Sherpa and beyond.
The program covers:

• What is SEO, and why it is important.

• How to manage a campaign successfully.

• How to interact with clients.

• How to conduct successful meetings.

• How to do keyword research and analyze search intent.

• Content creation strategies for search success.

• Comprehensive on-page optimization techniques (from A-Z).

• How to convert more traffic through Conversion Rate Optimisation (CRO).

• What is link building, and why you need it.

• How to build backlinks with blogger outreach and digital PR

• Technical SEO, techniques, and best practices

• And, much more!

This program is designed for post-graduates or someone with minimal professional SEO experience. The program begins with six weeks of dedicated, hands-on training across all of our agency functions. After that, you’ll be assigned an assessment so we can see how far you’ve come. Once done, a select few of you will continue for another six weeks (paid) where you’ll work on actual client projects - developing the skills you need to kick-start a career in search and content marketing.
No color-coordinating calendars, labeling files, or taking lunch orders when interning at SEO Sherpa . You’ll be working on real clients while gaining real-world experience working side-by-side with world-class experts.
Overview:

• We take you from zero to hero. Only post-graduates or those with minimal professional SEO experience should apply.

• A program covering approximately 20 hours per week of training.

• A priceless experience training you on all areas of SEO, and if brought over to the final six weeks, earn yourself $500

• Covers all aspects of content marketing and search engine marketing, end-to-end.

• Full-time roles are offered to selected top graduates.

The next program is still to be confirmed, however estimated to begin by the 2nd half of 2026.
The program is split into 2 cycles, the 1st cycle focuses on solely training; where you will get a 6 week program covering all areas of SEO. The Second cycle is another 6 weeks which transitions you through working alongside the team on client deliverables.

We are accepting applications throughout the year in preparation for the next internship. If selected we will reach out to you via email and confirm the actual start date.
Requirements
We are looking for passionate search marketers in the making. You should live and breathe digital marketing and are ready to learn new skills which you'll apply to real-world clients including fast-growth startups and world-leading brands.
Is This Program Right for You?
If you answer “YES” to all these it'll be a great fit….

• You have a well-rounded background steeped in digital marketing and/or communications.

• You’re results-driven, hungry to succeed - and excited to help our clients and agency do the same.

• You are bright, passionate, committed to getting the job done, and motivated to challenge yourself daily.

• You have exceptionally high standards. You are always raising the bar. In your world great isn't good enough.

• You're a focused and motivated self-starter, with excellent time management skills and a rock-solid work ethic.

• Lastly, you are passionate about digital marketing and have a fun-going attitude. This is a must.

title: Area Manager II, Warehouse
description:
Area Manager, Warehouse

Factor_ a brand of HelloFresh is seeking and Area Manager, Warehouse to support their Aurora, IL team.  In this position:  

You will ...

•   Oversee the strategic operations within the functional areas of receiving, shipping, storage / distribution of goods, and logistics.

•   Direct activities and provide coaching and guidance to associates, leads, and supervisors. 

•   Work alongside and with the team, providing guidance as needed to ensure maximum productivity. 

•   Work with senior Management to complete the given directives of the Company. 

•   Responsible for ensuring compliance with all safety, GMP and SQF policies/procedures, as well as adherence to PPE/hygiene policies. 

•   This managerial position is expected to cultivate a culture in line with Hello Fresh’s core values.

•    Ensure a high level of internal and external customer service. Investigate (and correct) customer issues and complaints.

•    Manages the department engaged in essential warehouse functions (receiving, shipping, and   distribution) to ensure high productivity and high technical integrity.

•     Performing internal audits.

•     Coordinate objectives with production procedures in cooperation with other plant managers to maximize product reliability and minimize costs.

•     Create and implement processes and procedures.

•     Relay quality philosophy to all warehouse personnel.

•     Maintain active role on internal continuous improvement teams.

•     Design, develop and implement warehousing training programs based on quarterly performance reviews

•     Interact with procurement to ensure adequate supply of all inventory and ingredients.

•     Addressing nonconformities from previous internal and external audits.

•     Conducting a management review of the warehouse essential functions.

•     Following-up on and closing pending preventive and corrective action requests.
